falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any daily session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break of the August 2024 equivalent structural low would invalidate the 74% bottom pattern match, as the prior bottom held that level; this would signal continuation lower not bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Blowoff score of 42 implies controlled fear/peak anxiety; sustained VIX >35 indicates panic escalation inconsistent with bottom formation and instead confirms distribution phase

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while SPX simultaneously trades below 5100
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Flight-to-safety bid in bonds with concurrent equity weakness signals recession fear dominance, invalidating the 'bottom' call which requires rates stability or rising yields on equity recovery

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
